const.jobDescription: Symfony on the back, and modern front (Nuxt / Next, Vue / React). I build applications from scratch, add features, and stabilize/optimize existing products.

hero.kicker: Symfony - Nuxt / Next - Vue / React - Python
hero.title: We build fast, clean, and with passion :D
hero.subtitle: I can develop custom applications for you, add features to an existing product, fix bugs and optimize the performance of your projects. Clear communication, clean pull requests, and regular deliveries.

bullets.label: Application from scratch: API, back-office, modern front
bullets.explanation:
API = the server part that exposes your data.
Back-office = admin interface.
Front = user-facing interface.

bullets.label: New features: smart breakdown, fast delivery
bullets.explanation:
Breakdown into small functions.
Delivery of testable features.
Validation as we go.

bullets.label: Bugs & performance: production stabilization + targeted optimizations
bullets.explanation:
Log analysis if existing.
Error fixes and query optimization.
Caching if needed.
Technical debt reduction (missing documentation, obsolete code, etc.)

items.title: 10h/month retainer
items.explanation: Perfect if you want regular support for maintenance, small updates or stabilization.

items.title: Stabilization & performance
items.explanation: When production is slow or unstable: quick audit, priority fixes, targeted optimizations, then an improvement plan. Duration depends on scope.

items.title: Custom application
items.explanation: For an MVP or complete application: I scope it and propose a delivery plan.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Simple formats, tailored for efficient collaboration: clear scope, clear communication, regular delivery.
offers.disclaimer:
Every project is different.
A call is worth a thousand messages! We clarify the context and area of impact, then I confirm a rate suited to complexity, timeline and urgency level.

retainer20.for: Perfect for delivering features continuously and reducing technical debt.

conditions: Listed rates do not include third-party costs (hosting, licenses, etc.).

proof.title: Proof (anonymized)
proof.subtitle: Most of my professional projects are private. Here are anonymized examples of what I do regularly.

items.title: Legacy product overhaul → API + performance + GDPR
items.context: Existing application (vanilla PHP), hard to maintain
items.problem: Slow performance, technical debt, no solid foundation to evolve + GDPR needs
items.actions: API design, progressive refactor, endpoint optimization, data security, GDPR rules implementation (minimization, access management, deletion/export).
items.result: Improved performance, more stable and maintainable base, faster evolution, better GDPR compliance.

items.title: Website overhaul (architecture)
items.context: Website to modernize + need for project clarity
items.problem: Outdated design/structure, hard to browse content, poorly optimized SEO/performance
items.actions: Page restructuring, modern front integration, image optimization, performance (LCP/CLS), project/testimonial sections, basic SEO (meta, structure, titles).
items.result: Clearer and more professional site, smoother navigation, better performance, more readable content to convert.

process.title: Process
process.subtitle: A simple method: scope fast, deliver clean, and stay visible.
